SPECIAL ABILITIES: Divine Casting (su) [phase i] Whenever Holy Dragon casts a spell that inflicts holy damage. She is healed for half of the damage done and reduces the holy resistance of the targets by 10 for 2d4+1 rounds (stacks up to 50). She can also double cast any spells below 6th level as a full-round action. During Phase II, double casting up to 9th level spells.

Guardian Angel (su) [phase i] Whenever Holy Dragon takes any damage, she casts Cure III on herself which uses 3 MP each time as a free action. During Phase II, she uses Cure IV instead using 4 MP each time as a free action.

Heartless Angel (su) [phase i] Once every 1d2+1 rounds as a standard action, Holy Dragon drops down a small sparkle of red light towards her target. Holy Dragon targets 1 creature within 60 feet and the target's current HP is reduced to 1 unless they make a Fortitude save (DC 37) to negate this effect. Blue mage may learn this ability as a 8th level spell (Knowledge: Arcana DC 31). During Phase II, she can uses this on all of her enemies within 60 ft. from her target.

Level ? Holy (su) [phase i] As a standard action, Holy Dragon releases beams of holy energy blasts towards all her enemies within a 30 ft. radius of her, exploding into intense light inflicting to all creatures with a total HD that is prime number dealing 20d8 points of holy damage and inflicting the dazzled status effect for 2d4 rounds. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 6th-level spell (Knowledge: Arcana DC 27). During Phase II, increase radius to 120 ft.

Heavenly Protection (su) [Begins Phase II] Once below 50% health (580), This Burst Mode lets Holy Dragon be guided by holy protection, giving her a blessing to fight with holy might. For a number of rounds equal to 1 + 1 round for every four HD, Holy Dragon gains a +8 sacred bonus to AC, saves, attack, and damage. She also gains 2d6 points of holy damage to all her melee attacks. This limit break requires only a swift action to activate.

primarySourceAttacks: Bite +39 (4d8+27 plus 3d6 holy damage), 2 claws +39 (3d8+18 plus 2d6 holy damage), 2 Wings +37 (2d8+9 plus 2d6 holy damage), tail slap +37 (3d8+27 plus 2d6 holy damage)

rulesDecisions: Actor data preserves the source statblock in biography and builder flags before any Foundry runtime hydration.
Only true feats, spells, and inventory placeholders are eligible for compendium lookup during import; creature-specific special abilities remain custom generated features.
Racial hit dice are generated from the creature type and source hit dice instead of creating class levels.
Source defensive text is mapped into FFD20 trait fields while unusual FF defenses remain preserved as custom text.
Natural attack items use source attack totals, source damage dice, and manual extra attacks for full-attack routines.
Spell and spell-like ability lines create spell placeholders that should hydrate from installed FFD20/PF spell compendiums.
Skill ranks are reverse-calculated from source totals after ability modifiers, racial modifiers, size modifiers, and class-skill bonuses.
